tags.validation_notes: QA 2026-11-20: Wall type confirmed (DAN, Advanced Diver Magazine). No source reviewed gives a measured wall depth; 40 m is nominal. Earlier 180-250 ft wall-extent claim could not be re-confirmed and was removed. Species from DAN and Advanced Diver Magazine. Operator page godspocket.com describes Browning Pass rather than naming the wall.

QA 2026-11-20: Mackenzie-class destroyer escort, 366 ft/111-112 m, 2,830 long tons (2,880 t) full load (Wikipedia) vs ~2,900 tons (ScubaBC); scuttled 14 June 1997 off Snake Island (Wikipedia, canada.ca, ScubaBC, ARSBC list; one dive article says October 1997). Depth reported 24-40 m by tide/structure; seabed ~130 ft (ScubaBC, X-Ray, DAN). Coordinates from ARSBC list (49 12.96N 123 53.07W). Marine life limited to species named at this wreck by NDO/ScubaBC/SDL/DAN.

QA 2026-11-20: Launched 7 Oct 1944 as HMS Flamborough Head; scuttled 20 Oct 2001 off Snake Island. Conflicts flagged in description: length 134.6 m (Wikipedia)/134 m (NDO)/442 ft (SDL)/~400 ft (X-Ray); class Cape vs Beachy Head (Wikipedia) vs Victory (SDL); displacement 8,580 vs 8,550 standard/11,270 full (Wikipedia); seabed 130-145 ft across sources. Coordinates from ARSBC list. Marine life limited to site-specific reports (NDO, ScubaBC, DAN).

QA 2026-11-20: Scuttled 4 April 2015 in Halkett Bay (Wikipedia, Hakai, ARSBC, X-Ray). Length 366 ft (Wikipedia, DAN) vs 371 ft/113 m (X-Ray, Hakai); depth 32 m (Wikipedia, Hakai) vs 105 ft/98 ft (ARSBC) vs ~110 ft (X-Ray, DAN); displacement and decommission date conflicts within Wikipedia noted in description. Coordinates from Wikipedia (49 26 57N 123 19 51W). Species from X-Ray first-year report and ARSBC; ABIS species counts ~80 (Hakai) to 170+ (ARSBC 2021).

QA 2026-11-20: MPA designated 1993 (Straight, BritishColumbia.com, DAN). Depths conflict: ridge 5-12 m, Whyte Islet ~15 m (VSDS), listed max ~20 m and reviewer ~30 m sandy bottom (Zentacle). 30 m retained as practical max. Species from VSDS, Zentacle, DAN. padi.com page returned 403 and was dropped.

QA 2026-11-20: Granthall 28 m steel tug (built 1928 per Waymarking, scuttled 1992, ScubaBoard/DAN/Waymarking agree on length and sinking); Centennial III dredge tender (DAN) vs crane barge (Waymarking); Nakaya sinking 1985 (Waymarking) vs late 1980s (ScubaBoard), depth ~33 m vs ~28 m. ARSBC PDF not readable and was dropped.

QA 2026-11-20: North islet slope to ~80 ft, south islet wall reported to 130 ft (single 2007 ScubaBoard post). Little to no current per three ScubaBoard posts. Sea lions reported by X-Ray Mag (Sunshine Coast). zentacle.com page returned 404 and was dropped.

QA 2026-11-20: Depth ~27 m/90 ft (Element Escapes; DAN wall from 70 ft plus ~20 ft). Current up to 9 knots (Element Escapes, DAN). Season conflict: fall (DAN) vs mild early-spring days (PNW Diving). Species from Element Escapes, DAN, PNW Diving.

QA 2026-11-20: ~17 km SW of Victoria; currents 5-7 kn (BritishColumbia.com), up to 8 kn (Visitor in Victoria). Marine area extends to 120 ft (BritishColumbia.com); no per-site dive depth found. coldoceandiver.ca could not be resolved and was dropped. Species are reserve-wide reports.

QA 2026-11-20: Breakwater ~800 m. Max depth conflict: ~24 m (Element Escapes), Flag 5 at 28-35 m (Zentacle), ~60 fsw outer section (ScubaBoard poster). 35 m is the upper reported figure. coldoceandiver.ca could not be resolved and was dropped.

QA 2026-11-20: Peak current 16 kn (Divernet, Scubaverse), 14-16 kn (X-Ray), up to 17.68 kn (Wikipedia); 'fastest' is contested (Nakwakto Rapids). Diveable-slack frequency conflicts (handful in four years vs 2-4 per month). No source gives a measured dive depth; 20 m nominal, DAN ~21 m at Observation Wall.

QA 2026-11-20: Park near Port Hardy; distance reported 10 km (BC Parks) to 20 km (Dive Magazine); 10 nm by boat (resort). Water temp 7-9 C (resort), 10.5 C (Dive Magazine), 44-54 F (DAN). No source gives site depths; 30 m nominal. Species are park-wide reports.

QA 2026-11-20: Madrona Point walls: Small ~15 m, Mid ~19 m, Big ~30 m (Element Escapes); Big Wall 95 ft/29 m (ScubaBC); Parksville Qualicum Beach Tourism gives ~90 ft. Species from ScubaBC, Element Escapes, Pacific Pro Dive. Unverified distance claims removed.

QA 2026-11-20: Max depth 131 ft/40 m (PADI), 40 m (DivePlanner Pro), walls beyond 130 ft (JustGottaDive). Coordinates from PADI (49.44959, -123.23946). Species from PADI, DivePlanner Pro, DAN. fvscuba.org, coldoceandiver.ca could not be resolved; zentacle.com page returned 404.
